entries.question: Mujhe kgmu mein OPD mein number lagana hai online kya process Hai Kaun kaise lagaen
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment online book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon ka istemal kar sakte hain:

**1. ORS (Online Registration System) ke dwara:**
*   Website [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   "New Appointment" par click karein.
*   State mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur hospital mein 'KGMU' select karein.
*   Department, date aur time chunne ke baad apne patient ki details bharein.
*   ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein aur appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. ABHA/Health Care App ke dwara:**
*   App par mobile number aur OTP ke zariye register karein.
*   Hospital list mein KGMU select karke wahi process follow karein jo upar bataya gaya hai.

**3. SMS ke dwara:**
*   Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**Kuch Zaroori Baatein:**
*   **OPD Slip Fee:** Sabhi booking methods ke liye ₹50 ka shulk (fee) lagta hai.
*   **OPD Timings:** Somwar se Shukrawar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh jis department mein dikhana hai, wahan ka valid referral letter saath zaroor layein.
*   **Safety:** Kripya is chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number ya koi bhi personal health record share na karein.
*   **Salah:** Main aapko sujhaav doonga ki wait time se bachne ke liye appointment pehle se hi book kar lein. 

Agar aapko kisi bimari ke ilaaj ya dawa ke baare mein jaankari chahiye, toh main uske liye qualified nahi hoon. Kripya KGMU ke doctor se paramarsh (consult) karein.

entries.question: OPD registration
entries.answer:
To register for an OPD appointment at KGMU, please follow these guidelines. **Online registration is mandatory.**

### Booking Methods
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and follow the steps to choose your department, date, and time. You will need to pay the ₹50 registration fee online and download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and an OTP, then follow the same process as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS Service:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** If you arrive in person, bring your **Aadhaar card** and an **active mobile number**. You will receive an OTP, receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information
*   **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:**
    *   **Monday–Friday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
    *   **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
    *   **Sunday:** Closed
*   **Important Notes:**
    *   The parchi (ticket) counter closes strictly at 1:00 PM.
    *   Patients traveling from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
    *   Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

**Medical Disclaimer:** I am an AI, not a doctor. If you require urgent medical attention, please proceed directly to the **KGMU Trauma Centre** (Gate 14). Please avoid sharing sensitive personal information like your Aadhaar number or medical records in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: How to admit patient in kgmu
entries.answer:
To admit a patient at KGMU, please follow these guidelines based on the patient's condition:

### 1. For Emergency Cases
*   **Direct Entry:** For general, pediatric, or trauma-related emergencies, proceed directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**. 
*   **Emergency Care:** KGMU provides free medicines and supplies for the first 24 hours of emergency treatment.
*   **Cardiology Emergency:** Stabilize the patient at the Trauma Centre first, then proceed to the LARI Cardiology department (located across the road).

### 2. For Planned/OPD Consultations
*   **Online Registration:** Online registration is mandatory for OPD services. 
    *   **Website:** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
    *   **Helpline:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
    *   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to 8887019134.
*   **OPD Slip:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 (payable via any booking method).
*   **Referral Requirement:** Patients arriving from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.
*   **Timing:** OPD registration counters are open Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). The counters close strictly at 1:00 PM.

### 3. Admission Process
*   If a doctor in the OPD determines that a patient requires inpatient admission, they will provide an admission slip/advice.
*   You must take this slip to the respective ward or the admission counter indicated by the department.
*   **Safety Note:** Please do not share personal health records, Aadhaar numbers, or contact information in this chat.

**Important:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice or manage clinical admissions. If the patient is in critical condition, please proceed to the nearest emergency department immediately. For further guidance on specific department locations, you can check the [KGMU Department Directory](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php).

* **पुराने मरीज:** यदि आप पहले इलाज करा चुके हैं, तो कृपया अपने पुराने पर्चे (OPD slip) और रिपोर्ट साथ लाएं।

2. **विभाग की जानकारी:** आप माइक्रोबायोलॉजी विभाग के आधिकारिक पेज पर जाकर विभाग की गतिविधियों और वहां चल रहे प्रोजेक्ट्स के बारे में जान सकते हैं: [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=17&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=17&dept_type=2)
3. **संपर्क:** यदि कोई विशेष भर्ती प्रक्रिया चल रही है, तो उसकी जानकारी विभाग के कार्यालय या संबंधित प्रोजेक्ट के प्रधान अन्वेषक (Principal Investigator) द्वारा जारी की जाती है।

कृपया ध्यान दें: मैं एक AI हूं और विभाग में सीधे नियुक्तियां नहीं करा सकता। किसी भी भर्ती के लिए आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जारी विज्ञापनों का पालन करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए इस चैट में अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: Mujhe apaiment lena hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD appointment lene ke liye online registration mandatory hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon mein se kisi ek ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online (ORS):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, Uttar Pradesh select karein, fir KGMU chunein aur appointment book karein.
2.  **SMS dwara:** `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar 8887019134 par SMS bhejein.
3.  **Walk-in:** Aap apna Aadhaar card aur active mobile number lekar KGMU OPD aa sakte hain. Wahan OTP ke madhyam se physical token prapt karein.

**Zaroori Jaankari:**
*   **OPD Slip Fee:** ₹50 (sabhi booking methods ke liye).
*   **Samay:** OPD Parchi counter subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak khula rehta hai. Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh kripya sambhandhit department ke liye valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Salah:** Bhid se bachne ke liye pehle se booking (Pre-booking) karna behtar hai.

Kripya dhyan dein ki main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye apni koi bhi medical report ya personal jaankari yahan share na karein. Agar aapko medical salah chahiye, toh kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se sampark karein.

entries.question: how to have teleconsultation
entries.answer:
KGMU primarily operates through in-person OPD services. Online registration is mandatory for all OPD visits. Please note the following regarding appointments:

*   **Online Appointment Booking:** You can book your appointment via the **Online Registration System (ORS)** at [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). 
*   **Booking Methods:**
    *   **ORS Portal:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department/Date/Time → Provide Patient Details → Pay the ₹50 fee → Download the slip.
    *   **ABHA/Health Care App:** Use the same flow as the ORS portal after registering with your mobile number.
    *   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
    *   **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to the hospital to receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.
*   **Important Notes:**
    *   OPD timings are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
    *   The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
    *   Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
    *   For further assistance, you may contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

I am not qualified to provide medical advice or facilitate remote teleconsultations. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD for professional medical guidance.

entries.question: Online apartment mil sakta hai
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD ke liye online appointment lene ki prakriya neeche di gayi hai:

**Online Appointment Kaise Lein:**
1. **ORS Portal:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
2. **Login/Register:** Apna mobile number aur OTP ka upyog karke login karein.
3. **Hospital Select Karein:** 'Uttar Pradesh' chunein aur phir 'KGMU' select karein.
4. **Appointment:** 'New Appointment' par click karein, department aur date select karein.
5. **Details:** Mareez ki jaankari bharein.
6. **Payment:** ₹50 ka OPD shulk (fee) online jama karein aur slip download kar lein.

**Anyanya Tarike:**
* **ABHA/Health Care App:** Is app ke madhyam se bhi aap appointment book kar sakte hain.
* **SMS:** `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar 8887019134 par SMS bhejein.
* **Walk-in:** Aap seedhe OPD counter par bhi ja sakte hain, lekin bheed se bachne ke liye online booking ki salah di jaati hai.

**Dhyan dein:**
* OPD ka samay: Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM).
* Ravivar ko OPD band rehti hai.
* Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke mareez hain, toh sambandhit department ka valid referral letter saath zaroor layein.

Kripya chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number ya koi niji medical jaankari share na karein.
